prompts.name: IP定位版
prompts.prompt: Edit the first attached review board into a refined V2 Chinese WeChat mini-program design board, FOUR mobile screens side by side, wide landscape. The second reference is the original “乡墅爆款视频” IP positioning UI: borrow its REAL BUSINESS FIELDS and profile purpose, NOT its desktop dark skin. Preserve the first reference's warm ivory backgrounds, white cards, brown buttons, WeChat headers and restrained mobile style. USER CORRECTION: creating a person is primarily IP positioning for future script rewriting. Remove administrative form fields such as 人物类型、内容方向、人物特色、引导行动 and remove long explanatory paragraphs. Make short labels, compact helpful examples and generous usable input areas. Entire board heading “人物库 · IP定位方案”, footer only “效果图示意”. Do not show API details or claims live integration works. Four screen labels: “01 人物库”, “02 新增人物 · IP定位”, “03 补充定位”, “04 定位预览”. SCREEN1 native header 人物库; two smaller feature entrances 口播分身 and 语音克隆, search 搜索人物, compact 新增人物 button. One card “张工（示例）” subtitle “乡墅设计师”, concise summary “自建房方案 · 户型优化 · 预算梳理”, chips “IP已完善”“分身未制作”“声音未克隆”, main card button “查看IP定位”. Empty irrelevant explanations omitted. SCREEN2 native header 新增人物; selected tab IP定位. Main card includes exactly five long-term positioning fields with clear labels: “姓名” example 张工; “身份” example 乡墅设计师; “服务范围” example 自建房方案、户型优化、预算梳理; “目标人群” example 准备建房的农村家庭; “表达特点” 3 chips 专业、通俗、不过度承诺. Beneath, compact collapsed accordion “补充定位（选填）” with chevron. Large bottom primary “保存定位”. No “保存后制作分身”, no automatic clone setup. SCREEN3 native header 补充定位, compact optional pill 选填. Four textarea fields referenced from actual original source: “客户关心的问题” example 预算、布局、施工避坑; “可引用的真实资料” placeholder 填写已核实的资料; “代表性口播” placeholder 粘贴一段认可的口播; “禁用表达与承诺” example 不承诺最低价，不保证固定工期. No lengthy hint paragraphs. bottom primary “保存补充信息”. SCREEN4 native header 人物详情; profile 张工（示例） / 乡墅设计师; 3 compact tabs IP定位（selected）,口播分身,语音克隆. “人物简介” card with concise text “我是张工，专注乡墅设计与预算梳理，为准备建房的农村家庭提供实用建议。表达专业、通俗，不过度承诺。” Bottom actions 编辑定位 and 用于文案二创; single small line “定位用于后续创作”. Generic outline avatar only, do not reproduce or invent a real human face. Ensure excellent readable Chinese, consistent mobile UI, minimal decorative text.

prompts.name: 分身声音精简版
prompts.prompt: Refine the attached four-phone UI mockup board into a concise V2: same FOUR screens, same warm ivory white brown restrained Chinese WeChat mini program design, same broad organization and same screen labels 05 口播分身,06 语音克隆,07 资源状态,08 数字人口播. Main heading “人物库 · 分身与声音”, footer only “效果图示意 · 状态为示例”. USER specifically requests much less explanatory text. REMOVE all long explanatory paragraphs at the top of all screens, all API/vendor names, all implementation commentary and any “当前代码限制仍需对齐” banners. Product interface must only use concise field labels and actionable controls. SCREEN5 WeChat header 口播分身; 所属人物 张工（示例） picker; 资源名称 张工分身; clean big dashed upload card icon plus 上传人物视频, tiny constraint MP4 · ≤50MB; compact checkbox 本人素材或已获授权; line 制作积分：以实时报价为准; brown button 确认制作. SCREEN6 WeChat header 语音克隆; 所属人物 张工（示例） picker; 资源名称 张工声音; upload box 选择声音样本; tiny constraint MP3 · 5秒–3分钟 · ≤20MB; compact authorization checkbox; line 制作积分：以实时报价为准; button 确认克隆. SCREEN7 header 人物资源, profile 张工（示例）; 2 clean rows 数字分身 · 张工分身 已就绪（示例）,克隆声音 · 张工声音 已就绪（示例） with 试听 button; one light progress row 制作中（示例）; refresh status button and primary 用于数字人口播. SCREEN8 header 数字人口播; fields 所属人物 张工（示例）,口播分身 张工分身,克隆声音 张工声音 and 试听; card 口播文案 with only short example “准备建房，先理清预算和居住需求。”; primary bottom button 生成口播视频, secondary small action 查看任务. No long footer instructions inside phones. No actual portraits, only outline icons and silhouette placeholders. Readable beautiful precise simplified Chinese labels; no fabricated exact prices, no actual success receipts.
